ai.seo_question: Who did Allah save from the great affliction in Surah As-Saffat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse specifically refers to the deliverance of Ibrahim and his family from the 'great pain' (al-karb al-azim) of the fire incident, emphasizing the preservation of the Prophet's household (Ahl al-Bayt) as a model of divine favor. The term 'ahlahu' is often interpreted by Shia scholars to include his wife and son, or more broadly, his spiritual lineage, underscoring the continuity of prophetic protection.
